editorial.thesis: A banking-and-healthcare city of about 131,000. Its retail is heavy on banks & atms and restaurants & fast food, and thin on desserts, sweets & ice cream and fitness & wellness — and 22% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 15% of Visakhapatnam's. 5.33 chain outlets per lakh residents against 35.21 in Visakhapatnam; 6 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Apollo Pharmacy 2, KFC 1, Reliance Smart / Fresh 1.

The mapped economy leans to banks & finance. Shares of all mapped places: banks & finance 12.0% (Visakhapatnam 8.2%); healthcare 14.3% (Visakhapatnam 10.2%); shops & retail 14.0% (Visakhapatnam 15.7%). Raw counts would mislead because Visakhapatnam is mapped more completely (12,251 places against 342), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 1 zones hold 22% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Ganapavaram alone has about 25,000 residents and 0 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is less concentrated than in Visakhapatnam. 44% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Visakhapatnam 49%). The largest cores are Bazar · Komaravallipadu (178 places) and Ganapavaram (5).

The widest brand gaps against Visakhapatnam. Apollo Pharmacy 2 outlets vs 112; MedPlus 0 outlets vs 35; Reliance Trends 1 outlets vs 22. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 5 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Visakhapatnam, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Bazar · Komaravallipadu and Ganapavaram are the largest zones by residents (86,000 and 25,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 44% of all commercial places, and Bazar · Komaravallipadu alone lists 178.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Bazar · Komaravallipadu holds 7 of the 7 tracked chain outlets, and Ganapavaram adds 0.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Bazar · Komaravallipadu and Ganapavaram lead on education places (23 and 2, with 5 and 0 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Ganapavaram. The blue cores include Bazar · Komaravallipadu.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (12,251 places in Visakhapatnam against 342 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Visakhapatnam; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Visakhapatnam, Chilakaluripet's mapped places over-index on banks & finance (12.0% vs 8.2%), healthcare (14.3% vs 10.2%), education (10.2% vs 8.3%) and under-index on shops & retail (14.0% vs 15.7%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 7 outlets of 6 tracked national brands within 5 km — 5.33 per lakh residents against Visakhapatnam's 35.21 (322 outlets of 36 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Visakhapatnam are Apollo Pharmacy (2 vs 112); MedPlus (0 vs 35); Reliance Trends (1 vs 22). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Visakhapatnam's, so low means thin by Visakhapatnam's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 5 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Chilakaluripet's age mix against Visakhapatnam: children (0–14) 20.3% vs 21.4%, 15–24 19.3% vs 18.8%, working age 49.9% vs 51.0%, 60+ 10.6% vs 8.8%. Under-25s are 40% of residents.

zones.522616: About 86,000 residents, 178 mapped places (retail depth index 112), 7 chain outlets.
zones.522619: An under-served zone: about 25,000 residents, 5 mapped places, 0 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 11.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.0% of mapped places against 4.9% in Visakhapatnam, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: KFC 1 (Visakhapatnam 14). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Biryani By Kilo, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 1.5% of mapped places against 1.7% in Visakhapatnam — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Sutta Bar, Chai Point, Blue Tokai.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.3% of mapped places against 1.0% in Visakhapatnam — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 2.3% of mapped places against 2.6% in Visakhapatnam, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 1 (Visakhapatnam 7), Spencer's 1 (Visakhapatnam 9), Vishal Mega Mart 1 (Visakhapatnam 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.5% of mapped places against 1.9% in Visakhapatnam — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 2 (Visakhapatnam 112). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 5.3% of mapped places against 5.7% in Visakhapatnam, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Trends 1 (Visakhapatnam 22).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 12.0% of mapped places against 8.2% in Visakhapatnam — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 1.5% of mapped places against 1.4% in Visakhapatnam, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 1.5% of mapped places against 3.1% in Visakhapatnam — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
